en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a winter scene with many people ice skating in front of a long neoclassical building. The ground is covered in snow, and skaters in early 20th‑century clothing glide across the ice. The building behind them has large arched windows and a central entrance with steps and columns. Tall leafless trees frame the scene. At the top of the postcard is a printed caption in German indicating the location in Graz and referring to an ice-skating rink and gymnasium.
